starts with enabled remote debugging on port 9229 and waits for a Debugger Connection before executing your code

Using CLI options (see options tab) it's possible to activate the remote debugging capabilites of NodeJS. Hereby you can decide whether to simply enable the functionality using '--inspect' or breaking before executing any of your code and waiting for a remote inspector connection by using '--inspect-brk'.
node.debug's "Console" Tab also gives you easy access to node.script's stdout and stderr output
